extracted.intended_audience: students, researchers, policymakers, and members of the general public seeking country reference data
extracted.subtask_description: Structured country profiles (Factbook-style) summarizing geography, population, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues with quantitative indicators and short narrative overviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Short narrative history/context for the country (e.g., recent political history, conflicts, independence, coups, peace accords).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as free-text paragraphs summarizing key historical and political developments affecting the country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic placement phrased as region and bordering bodies/countries (e.g., 'Northern Africa, bordering the Red Sea, between Egypt and Eritrea').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise location sentence identifying continent/subregion and principal neighbors or maritime boundaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates for the country's approximate center (e.g., '15 00 N, 30 00 E').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as degrees/minutes N/S and E/W.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to map or regional context (e.g., 'Africa', 'South America').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One-word or short-region designation used to categorize map placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Area
rubrics_metrics.description: Total area with breakdowns for water and land (e.g., 'total: 2,505,810 sq km; water: 129,810 sq km; land: 2.376 million sq km').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in square kilometers with components for water and land.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Area comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparative size phrasing (e.g., 'slightly more than one-quarter the size of the US').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short comparative sentence to give reader scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of land boundaries and list of bordering countries with lengths (e.g., 'total: 7,687 km; border countries: ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric total plus per-border breakdown when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Coastline length in km (e.g., '853 km').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single numeric value in kilometers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard maritime jurisdiction statements (territorial sea, contiguous zone, continental shelf, exclusive economic zone).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in nautical miles or depth/exploitation phrasing as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: Short description of dominant climatic zones and seasonal patterns (e.g., 'tropical in south; arid desert in north; rainy season varies by region').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One- or two-sentence synopsis of climate features and variations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Brief description of the physical terrain (e.g., 'generally flat, featureless plain; mountains in far south').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise summary highlighting major physiographic features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest points with elevations (e.g., 'lowest point: Red Sea 0 m; highest point: Kinyeti 3,187 m').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as named location and altitude in meters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of principal natural resources (e.g., 'petroleum; small reserves of iron ore, copper...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated list highlighting major extractive or renewable resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent breakdown of land use categories (arable land, permanent crops, other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as percentages with year when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land in square kilometers (e.g., '19,500 sq km (1998 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric area plus year estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Noted frequent hazards (e.g., 'dust storms and periodic persistent droughts').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short enumeration of major environmental risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal environmental concerns (e.g., inadequate potable water, deforestation, soil erosion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short narrative bullet listing current environmental problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international environmental agreements the country is party to or has signed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated treaty acronyms/names with indication of status (party/signed/not ratified).

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Population
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population with date or estimate year (e.g., '39,148,162 (July 2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric population with month/year estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent or counts by age cohorts (0-14, 15-64, 65+) with male/female breakdown when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as percentages and often absolute male/female counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age overall and by sex (e.g., 'total: 17.9 years; male: 17.7; female: 18.1').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in years with breakdowns where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate with year of estimate (e.g., '2.64% (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent per year with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Birth and death rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude birth and death rates per 1,000 population (e.g., '35.79 births/1,000 population').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as rate per 1,000 with year estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migration per 1,000 population with year (e.g., '-0.02 migrant(s)/1,000 population').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signed rate per 1,000 with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Sex ratio by age groups and total (e.g., 'at birth: 1.05 male(s)/female').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ratios supplied for several cohorts when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant mortality per 1,000 live births with sex breakdowns when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as deaths per 1,000 live births with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy overall and by sex in years (e.g., 'total population: 58.13 years; male: 56.96; female: 59.36').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Years with estimate year indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Children per woman (e.g., '4.97 children born/woman').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as average children per woman with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - HIV/AIDS statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Adult prevalence rate, people living with HIV/AIDS, and deaths (where provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-part reporting: prevalence %, number living with HIV, annual deaths.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Major infectious diseases / health risks
rubrics_metrics.description: List of prevalent infectious diseases and overall degree of risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short list plus qualitative risk assessment (e.g., 'very high').

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Nationality / Ethnic groups / Religions / Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Nationality terms, ethnic composition percentages, principal religions, and language use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated lists with percentage breakdowns when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: People - Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Literacy definition and percent literate overall and by sex (e.g., 'total population: 61.1%; male: 71.8%; female: 50.5% (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with definition (age 15 and over) and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government - Country name and forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventional long/short forms and local names and former names.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List of formal names used for the country in English and local language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government - Government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Short description of governance system (e.g., 'authoritarian regime - ruling military junta').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One-line regime type with brief qualifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government - Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of capital city.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single place name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government - Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Number and names (or types) of first-level administrative units (states, provinces, districts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List/count of divisions with local terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government - Independence / National holiday / Constitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Independence date, national holiday, and constitution details (dates, suspension notes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise dated facts with noteworthy legal status notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government - Legal system / Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal tradition and voting age/eligibility (e.g., 'based on English common law and Islamic law'; 'suffrage: 17 years of age').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short description of legal mix and suffrage rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief of state, head of government, vice presidents, cabinet composition, term lengths, and election notes/results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Names and offices, election dates, percent vote and commentary when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure (unicameral/bicameral), number of seats, methods of selection, term lengths, and recent election notes/results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric and descriptive reporting of legislative composition and elections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Top courts and any special court types (e.g., Supreme Court; Special Revolutionary Courts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Court names and brief institutional notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: List of major parties and party leaders (often with acronyms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated list with bracketed leader names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political pressure groups and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Named pressure groups, religious groups, unions, insurgent organizations and leaders when relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short enumerated list highlighting influential non-party actors.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country participates in (acronyms given).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated list of organizations; observer status noted when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation (in US / from US)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chiefs of mission, embassy/consulate locations, addresses, telephone and fax numbers for bilateral representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact-style entries: mission head, addresses, phone/fax, and consular posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Textual heraldic/visual description of the national flag (colors, symbols, layout).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sentence describing flag panels, colors, symbols and notable details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Short narrative describing economic model, major sectors, recent performance and structural issues (e.g., 'market-oriented policies and export-oriented trade').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Free-text paragraph summarizing key economic characteristics and recent trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - GDP (purchasing power parity)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP expressed in PPP dollar value with estimate year (e.g., 'purchasing power parity - $73.7 billion (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary amount with year and 'PPP' qualifier.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - GDP real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual real GDP growth rate with estimate year (e.g., '5.5% (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent growth with year reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - GDP per capita (PPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP per capita on a purchasing power parity basis with year (e.g., '$3,700 (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary amount per person with PPP note and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - GDP composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent contributions of agriculture, industry, and services to GDP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-part percent breakdown commonly reported with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Investment share of GDP (e.g., '22.7% of GDP (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent of GDP with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Population below poverty line
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of population below poverty line with year when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentage with year estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Household income or consumption by percentage share
rubrics_metrics.description: Shares of total income/consumption by lowest and highest deciles (e.g., 'lowest 10%: 3.5%; highest 10%: 28%').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by decile with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Distribution of family income - Gini index
rubrics_metrics.description: Gini coefficient for income distribution (e.g., '34.4 (1995)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric Gini index with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual consumer price inflation percent with year (e.g., '6.3% (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent with year estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Labor force and occupation breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Total labor force size and percent by sector (agriculture, industry, services).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric labor force and percent occupational distribution with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Unemployment rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported unemployment percent with year (e.g., '8.4% (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent unemployed with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Budget (revenues and expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual government revenues and expenditures in dollars with year (and capital expenditures noted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary values with year and possible notes on capital expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Public debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Public debt as percent of GDP or dollar amount with year (e.g., '105.1% of GDP (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent or amount reported with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Agriculture products
rubrics_metrics.description: List of principal agricultural products (e.g., 'rice, sugarcane, tea, rubber, coconuts').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comma-separated listing of major crops and products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Industries / Industrial production growth
rubrics_metrics.description: Key industrial sectors and recent industrial production growth rate (percent with year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sector list and numeric growth percent with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Electricity statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity production, consumption, exports, and imports in kWh with year estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric values in kWh and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Oil statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil production and consumption in barrels per day, plus exports/imports and proved reserves when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: bbl/day figures and reserve volumes with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Current account balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Current account balance in dollars with year (e.g., '$-278 million (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary surplus/deficit value and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Exports and imports (values, commodities, partners)
rubrics_metrics.description: Export/import totals in dollars, major commodities exported/imported, and principal trade partners with percent shares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary totals plus commodity lists and partner percentages with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Reserves of foreign exchange & gold
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign exchange and gold reserves in dollars with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary value and estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Debt - external
rubrics_metrics.description: External debt in dollars with year (e.g., '$10.52 billion (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary amount and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Economic aid - recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of economic aid received (dollars) with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary value and year when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - Currency / Code / Exchange rates / Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Currency name, ISO code, historical exchange rates to USD, and fiscal year convention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Currency identification plus example exchange rates by year and fiscal year type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - Telephones and system
rubrics_metrics.description: Main telephone lines in use, mobile cellular subscriptions, and qualitative assessment of the telephone system (domestic and international).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric line and mobile counts plus short system description and country code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - Broadcast stations and ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: Numbers of radio and television broadcast stations and counts of radios/televisions in use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts of stations and household device totals with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - Internet
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet country code, number of hosts, number of ISPs, and estimated number of internet users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short list of internet infrastructure indicators with numeric counts and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - Railways / Highways / Waterways
rubrics_metrics.description: Lengths of railways, total and paved/unpaved highways, and navigable waterways with year estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric totals and gauge/type details where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - Ports and harbors / Merchant marine / Airports
rubrics_metrics.description: Major ports, merchant fleet composition and total GRT/DWT, number of airports and runway surface breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named ports plus numeric fleet and airport runway breakdowns by length categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - Pipelines / Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: Lengths of oil/gas/refined product pipelines and counts of heliports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric lengths (km) for pipelines and counts for heliports with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military - Military branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Names of principal military branches and relevant police or paramilitary forces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short enumerated list (Army, Navy, Air Force, Police Force, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military - Manpower statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Military age and obligation, availability, fit-for-service counts, and annual numbers reaching military age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric counts and age/obligation rules with year estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military - Military expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending in dollars and as percent of GDP with year estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-part reporting: absolute dollar figure and percent of GDP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues - Disputes and refugee flows
rubrics_metrics.description: International disputes, cross-border effects of conflict, refugees by origin, and internally displaced persons (IDPs) counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative on disputes and numeric refugee/IDP counts with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page metadata - Last updated
rubrics_metrics.description: Date the country entry was last updated on the page (e.g., 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single date string indicating last revision of the entry.
